Question B-001-015-007.

Why the correct answer is right: The 40-metre band range tested for Canada is 7.0 MHz to 7.3 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "6.5 MHz to 6.8 MHz": This range is below the 7.0 MHz lower edge of the 40-metre band.
- sourceIndex 2: "6.0 MHz to 6.3 MHz": This range is also below the 7.0 MHz to 7.3 MHz 40-metre allocation.
- sourceIndex 3: "7.7 MHz to 8.0 MHz": This range lies above the 7.3 MHz upper edge of the 40-metre band.
